quotes.text: "A default account not yet initialized should not lose its status to another account"
"The default account should have retained its status."

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The fixture stores account2 as default while server2 has an invalid type. It expects a null default, adds a different valid account and still expects null. After unloading accounts and changing server2 to pop3, it expects account2 as default. These assertions check that the unavailable stored default is not replaced by the newly created account; they simulate availability rather than run an extension restart.
title: The custom-account test preserves a stored default while its server is unavailable
